name: Water ready
description: Score whether the household has enough safe drinking, cooking, sanitation, and pet water for the target duration.
scoring_question: Do we have stored water, containers, filtration/treatment, and a ration plan?
evidence_to_check: Gallons/liters on hand, filter status, treatment tablets, storage dates, pet water.

name: Power ready
description: Score whether critical devices can remain powered during outage, evacuation, or shelter-in-place.
scoring_question: Can we charge phones, REM devices, hub/radio gear, lights, and medical devices?
evidence_to_check: Battery banks charged, solar/generator tested, fuel ready, cables labeled, medical-device backup runtime known.

name: Comms ready
description: Score whether REM, peers, Reticulum node, hub, fallback contacts, and communication drill steps are ready.
scoring_question: Can each trusted person send and receive chat, Event/MECP, and emergency updates?
evidence_to_check: Call signs set, peers paired, Ready state confirmed, announce/test message completed, fallback contact list printed.

name: Medical ready
description: Score whether medications, first aid, health notes, dependent needs, and medical-device power are prepared.
scoring_question: Can we handle routine medications, first aid, chronic needs, mobility needs, and urgent notes?
evidence_to_check: First-aid kit, medication supply, prescription copies, medical contacts, mobility aids, device batteries, pet meds.
